message.content:
Sure! Use the `maxsplit` argument of `str.split()` so it only splits on the first `=`:

```python
temp = "hello=good="
parts = temp.split('=', 1)   # split at most once
print(parts)                # ['hello', 'good=']
```

`maxsplit=1` tells Python to perform only one split, leaving any remaining `=` characters in the second part.
